title: Your first pull request
concept: Open a pull request; ask for a review

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: Your branch is online, but nobody has looked at it.

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: A **pull request** says: "please look at my branch, then put it into main".

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: It is a conversation attached to your changes. Teammates can read the diff and comment.

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: Open the Pull requests tab and make one. Compare `food-stalls`, into `main`.

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: Then open the Files changed tab and read your own diff before anyone else does.

items.text: Open a pull request from food-stalls into main
Answer: what does a pull request contain?

hints: Use the website panel, not the terminal. Pull requests live on the website.
Open the Pull requests tab and press New pull request. Compare is your branch, base is main.
In the website panel: Pull requests → New pull request → compare `food-stalls`, base `main` → give it a title → Create pull request.

questions.prompt: What is in a pull request?

choices.text: A copy of your files that replaces main straight away
A request to merge a branch, plus the diff and a place to talk about it

questions.explanation: Opening a pull request changes nothing yet. It asks for review and shows exactly what would change.

recap: A pull request asks for a branch to be merged. It shows the diff and gives teammates a place to comment. Opening one changes nothing by itself.
